title: Chapter 169: The Impact Of Zerg Joining The War

Chapter 169: The Impact Of Zerg Joining The War

Naga you killed three giant dog demons and stopped attacking. Wu Qing could see that her consumption was not very large, but she no longer needed to attack.

The remaining dog demons, the Zerg puppies did not give the Naga warriors any chance. Without the threat of the dog demons' fire, they rushed over and drowned the remaining dog demons.

On the battlefield, the demon army had less than 100,000 soldiers, and all the strongest dog demons were lost.

The command of the demon army was also very peculiar. After the death of the three strongest giant dog demons, the remaining demon army did not fall into chaos, but was able to organize effectively and fight.

The secret of this, the old rival of the demon clan, the Naga clan, has not yet figured it out.

The war between the Naga clan and the demon clan was against an organized army. No matter how they fought, it was rare for the demon army to fight on its own.

On the battlefield, the demon army, which was somewhat scattered by the long-range attacks of the explosive mosquitoes and the Naga warriors, quickly organized itself and had a tendency to form an effective defense.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Another group of Zerg Explosive Swarms rushed into the Demon Army and disrupted their formation.

The small number of Explosive Swarms can actually kill not many enemies, but the powerful energy impact generated by their explosion and the splashing Zerg biodegradation liquid can effectively disrupt the enemy's formation and prevent them from quickly forming an effective offensive and defensive formation.

After this explosion, the Zerg Explosive Swarms stopped attacking. There were exactly 600 of them left. There were many explosions just now, but in fact, not many Explosive Swarms were consumed each time.

The Zerg can also make money by relying on Explosive Swarms to eliminate the enemy, but there is no need to adopt this tactic unless it is absolutely necessary.

This tactic requires a lot of gas resources, which feels very uneconomical. If you really want to play like this, you might as well use these gas resources to send more Zerg Hydralisks. Hydralisks can almost destroy a large number of enemies without loss.

The reason why the Zerg also uses Zerg Zerglings to fight consumption is because the Zerg Zerglings are only worth 25 energy, which is really a good deal!

Now the Zerg Zerglings can easily fight against the non-star soldiers. Few soldiers are their opponents. They can earn more than enough money by killing an ordinary enemy, and can also earn some gas resources. This is a profitable business.

There are many ways to obtain energy resources, and it is much easier. It is not a problem for Zerg Zerglings to come up with as many as they want. They are born to be the cannon fodder soldiers of the Zerg. This is their positioning!

Therefore, the Zerg will let Zerg Zerglings go to any battle that can be fought with Zerg Zerglings. Zerg Zerglings are the basic Zerg soldiers that the Zerg has summarized and optimized after countless wars. They are the soldiers with the highest overall combat efficiency of the Zerg.

When going out to assist the Naga tribe, the main force is the Zerg Zerglings, which can be consumed as much as possible. The explosive mosquitoes are just a backup means to deal with special situations. They will not be used if they can be used.

The real powerful Zerg soldiers do not have many troops now, and Wu Qing has other uses.

On the battlefield, the Zerg puppies rushed towards the remaining demon army. The Naga army resigned itself to taking on the role of long-range soldiers and calmly launched long-range attacks on the enemy in a safe area.

The Naga warriors wanted to participate in close combat, but the Zerg puppies would not give them a chance.

With the cooperation of both sides, the remaining demon army was finally wiped out before the sun set.

The demons are a famous fighting race in the evil god camp, with a tradition of fighting to the death.

They are not controlled by faith, but are naturally like this.

On the battlefield, most of the bodies of the demons turned into light and disappeared, and there were not many left. The casualties of the Naga warriors were very few. Only the Naga warriors who participated in the encirclement and suppression of close combat suffered a small number of casualties.

As soon as the battle was over, Naga arranged for people to set up a super-large-scale fortune array on the battlefield, which very generously covered the two nearby battlefields. It was completely unlike the stingy Tengu tribe, who even saved the fortune array.

After two major battles, the Zerg puppies were reduced to about 60,000, and the losses were very heavy.

In the battle with the demons, in order to end the battle before dark, the Zerg puppies were fighting with the demon army with their lives. The demons, who were also famous for their strong combat power, were enough to cause a lot of casualties to the Zerg puppies.

After Naga arranged the matter of the fortune array, she found host No. 3. She looked at the Zerg troops with serious casualties and solemnly saluted the Zerg army and host No. 3.

Thanked: "The Zerg's affection will be remembered by the Naga tribe forever!"

As an elder of the Naga tribe, it is very rare to say such words to another race.

The Zerg puppies fought in the front, their main purpose was for resources, and their secondary purpose was to help the Naga tribe.

But their performance, in the eyes of outsiders, is that they are selfless good people.

Combined with the fact that the Zerg is a race that has just entered the world, it is easy to associate the Zerg with labels such as hot-blooded, simple, loyal, and ignorant of human relationships.

No matter how you think of the Zerg, everyone likes the Zerg. The Zerg are just like people who are stupid and rich, and everyone likes to make friends with such people.

The Naga tribe is a relatively straightforward tribe, and Naga and Nagalong's gratitude to the Zerg is from the heart.

As an elder of a large tribe, Naga manages a territory and has a good ability to identify people and things. She can see the extraordinary features of the Zerg from many details, and they are sincere friends.

"Everyone has the responsibility to resist the invasion of the evil god camp. The Zerg has just entered the world and should take more responsibility!"

Wu Qing talked to Naga through Host No. 3.

"With today's victory, the pressure on our tribe will be reduced, and the noble army can rest for a while!"

Naga said.

Today's two battles are indeed very critical. If the Naga tribe suffers too much loss here, it will affect the entire Naga tribe's defense line.

Successfully eliminated a main force of the bear goblin tribe, plus a large army of the demon tribe that was chasing after them. The main force of the Naga tribe suffered little loss, and the army losses in the surrounding territories were also very slight.

The difference between this plus and minus will be very obvious. It is not easy for the bear goblin tribe in this area to organize a large-scale invasion again. The flank of the Naga tribe can be stable for a while.

The loss of a large army of the demon tribe will reduce the pressure on the entire defense line of the Naga tribe a lot, and the precarious defense line is considered to be stable.

The elder of the Naga tribe led the army to support, but was chased by a large army of demons. It can be seen how difficult the situation of the Naga tribe was before.

"The meaning of Zerg life is fighting! It is the honor of every Zerg to die on the battlefield and return to the embrace of the master!"

"The second batch of Zerg reinforcements will arrive tomorrow, please let us continue to fight!"

Wu Qing said righteously through host No. 3.

Such a profitable business must continue to invest, and the second batch of Zerg reinforcements must be prepared immediately and rush over tomorrow to continue fighting.

Host No. 3 didn't even have a face, only mental fluctuations, and Naga didn't know how to look at its righteous expression.

She opened her mouth, but finally held back and said, thinking for a while, "In that case, the tribe just replenished a batch of luck beads for us. Knowing that the nobles are in urgent need of luck development, we will give them a batch of luck beads as a gift!"

"We will do our best to help the nobles develop!"

"I hope that the two tribes will always be friends, watch over each other, and play a more important role in the war against the invasion of the evil god camp!"

Naga also said this.

"Tomorrow I will arrange for people to escort this batch of luck beads and some more valuable materials to the noble territory!"

The Naga tribe is willing to give a large amount of luck directly to the Zerg. Wu Qing is of course happy. With luck, there will be gas resources, and the Zerg can have more powerful troops.

Wu Qing is not polite, this is the reward he deserves.

"Tomorrow, our tribe will have a transport team with the second batch of reinforcements, so there is no need to trouble the nobles to help transport!"

It's just that the luck beads and some valuable materials are not transported in large quantities. Wu Qing plans to let the Zerg transport them to avoid the insufficient escort force arranged by the Naga tribe and accidents.

As night fell, Naga and Wu Qing continued to chat for a while through Host No. 3, and they got to know each other better before they went their separate ways.

The entire battlefield was protected by the luck formation diagram with sufficient luck supply, which isolated the weirdness and gave the Naga army time to clean up the battlefield.

Because there were not many corpses on the battlefield, the weirdness was not very attractive, so there was no large-scale gathering of weirdness here.

Cleaning up the battlefield mainly involved cleaning up the large amount of equipment and supplies left by the bear goblin army. The demon army, like the Zerg army, was left with nothing.

The battlefield was very safe, and the Zerg army gathered together and entered a rest and standby state, which was very quiet.

Wu Qing was not going to expose the Zerg's ability to drill into the ground for the time being, so he could only stay on the ground and recover slowly, and the explosive mosquito also fell into the group of puppies.

On the battlefield, only the busy Naga army was left. When they saw the Zerg army collectively enter a resting state, no one came to disturb them again.

Only the spiritual power of Host No. 3 was still active, and the Queen of the Zerg was constantly collecting information about the Naga tribe through it.

…

Recovery City, the Alliance army was cleaning up the ruins in the city all day. Many lords of races that are good at construction in the territories sent people back to transfer a lot of professional construction personnel to use the ready-made materials in the city to repair the damaged city buildings.

This big city originally built by the Tengu tribe can easily provide a living for hundreds of thousands of people. The Zerg does not monopolize it, and all territories in the Alliance can travel freely.

Therefore, all lords in the Alliance are very active in building this city. Many lords of small territories with poor territorial environments plan to stay in Recovery City in the future.

However, in the overall plan, Recovery City will temporarily bear the heavy responsibility of counterattacking the forward base of the evil god camp, mainly for garrisoning troops.
